knowledge:
- key_parameters: dds=A DESeqDataSet object containing raw counts and experimental design metadata ;; dst=A DESeqTransform object containing normalized, variance-stabilized expression values (e.g., from rlog or VST) ;; countmatrix=A matrix of raw counts used as alternative input to launch the app ;; coldata=A data frame of experimental covariates matching the columns of countmatrix ;; annotation=A data frame mapping gene IDs to readable symbols, requiring a gene_name column ;; pca2go=An enrichment object containing GO terms associated with high-loading genes per PC ;; intgroup=Character vector of covariates in colData to use for grouping/coloring samples in PCA plots ;; ntop=Number of most variable genes to use for computing PCA
- alternatives: limmaquickpca2go=A faster alternative to pca2go for live functional enrichment, relying on limma::goana instead of topGO (which is more precise but slower) ;; mosdef::run_topGO=Preferred over the deprecated topGOtable function (from version 2.32.0 onwards) for robust GO enrichment analysis ;; webshot2=Uses headless Chrome (via chromote) as an alternative to webshot (which uses PhantomJS) for rendering HTML widgets in report previews
- when_to_use: Use when performing exploratory data analysis (EDA) on RNA-seq datasets to detect outlier samples, identify batch effects or dominant sources of variation, visualize gene expression profiles, and interpret the biological meaning of principal components via functional enrichment.
- pitfalls: Mismatched sample names: Row names of coldata must exactly match the column names of countmatrix (or dds) ;; Yeast annotation: When using get_annotation_orgdb for yeast (Saccharomyces cerevisiae with org.Sc.sgd.db), key_for_genenames must be explicitly specified to avoid errors ;; Missing gene_name column: The annotation data frame must contain at least one column named exactly gene_name containing gene symbols ;; HTML widget rendering in reports: DataTable objects and other HTML widgets may not render correctly in the report preview unless PhantomJS (via webshot) or headless Chrome (via webshot2) is installed ;; Normalization assumption: The default size factor estimation assumes most genes are not differentially expressed; if violated, custom normalization factors must be pre-computed and stored in the input dds object.

workflows.name: interactive_pca_exploration
workflows.intent: Launch the interactive Shiny application for comprehensive RNA-seq exploration using pre-computed DESeq2 objects and gene annotations.
workflows.stages: 1. Retrieve gene annotations using get_annotation_orgdb ;; 2. Pre-compute functional enrichment of PC loadings using pca2go ;; 3. Launch the interactive Shiny app using pcaExplorer
workflows.code:
anno_df_orgdb <- get_annotation_orgdb(dds = dds_airway, orgdb_species = "org.Hs.eg.db", idtype = "ENSEMBL")
pca2go_airway <- pca2go(rld_airway, annotation = annotation_airway, organism = "Hs", ensToGeneSymbol = TRUE, background_genes = bg_ids)
pcaExplorer(dds_airway,rld_airway, pca2go = pca2go_airway, annotation = annotation_airway)

workflows.name: standalone_pca_and_covariate_correlation
workflows.intent: Perform programmatic PCA, plot sample distributions, and correlate principal components with experimental covariates.
workflows.stages: 1. Plot sample PCA using pcaplot ;; 2. Generate a scree plot of explained variance using pcascree ;; 3. Correlate principal components with sample covariates using correlatePCs ;; 4. Plot the correlation significance matrix using plotPCcorrs ;; 5. Extract and plot genes with the highest loadings using hi_loadings
workflows.code:
pcaplot(rld_airway,intgroup = c("cell","dex"),ntop = 1000, pcX = 1, pcY = 2, title = "airway dataset PCA on samples - PC1 vs PC2")
pcaobj_airway <- prcomp(t(assay(rld_airway)))
pcascree(pcaobj_airway,type="pev", title="Proportion of explained proportion of variance - airway dataset")
res_pcairway <- correlatePCs(pcaobj_airway,colData(dds_airway))
plotPCcorrs(res_pcairway)
hi_loadings(pcaobj_airway,topN = 10,exprTable=counts(dds_airway))
hi_loadings(pcaobj_airway,topN = 10,annotation = annotation_airway)

workflows.name: gene_level_pca_and_profiling
workflows.intent: Analyze and visualize gene-level PCA biplots and expression profiles across samples.
workflows.stages: 1. Compute and plot gene-level PCA biplots using genespca ;; 2. Plot expression distributions across samples using distro_expr ;; 3. Plot standardized expression profiles for a subset of genes using geneprofiler
workflows.code:
groups_airway <- colData(dds_airway)$dex
cols_airway <- scales::hue_pal()(2)[groups_airway]
genespca(rld_airway,ntop=100, choices = c(1,2), arrowColors=cols_airway,groupNames=groups_airway, alpha = 0.7, varname.size = 5, annotation = annotation_airway )
distro_expr(rld_airway,plot_type = "boxplot")
dds <- makeExampleDESeqDataSet_multifac(betaSD_condition = 3,betaSD_tissue = 1)
dst <- DESeq2::rlogTransformation(dds)
set.seed(42)
geneprofiler(dst,paste0("gene",sample(1:1000,20)), plotZ = FALSE)
